description: This file defines the high-level API interface for Energy-Efficient Ethernet (EEE) functionality in the RTL8367/RTL8367C switch. It includes function declarations for initializing EEE, enabling/disabling EEE on specific ports, and retrieving port configuration status.

methods.name: rtk_eee_init
methods.description: Initializes the EEE (Energy-Efficient Ethernet) subsystem in the device.

methods.name: rtk_eee_portEnable_set
methods.description: Sets the EEE enable status for a specific port.

methods.name: rtk_eee_portEnable_get
methods.description: Retrieves the EEE enable status for a specific port.
